summary: Implemented comprehensive E2E testing suite for Flowly workflow project covering Python API tests (workflow CRUD, execution, NL workflow, streaming), Python streaming tests (SSE events), Playwright E2E tests (NL creator, workflow execution), test utilities (conftest.py, helpers.py), and environment configuration. Tests are designed to be skipped gracefully when backend or Ollama is not running.

notes: Tests were created but not executed because Django dev server is not running at http://localhost:8000. Many tests require Ollama to be available (controlled by OLLAMA_AVAILABLE env var). The test suite uses @pytest.mark.skipif decorators to gracefully skip tests when infrastructure is unavailable. Key endpoints tested: POST /api/v1/workflows/{id}/execute/, POST /api/v1/workflows/{id}/stream_execute/, POST /api/v1/nl-workflow/sessions/, POST /api/v1/nl-workflow/stream/, GET /api/v1/gateway/health/. Existing Playwright tests found in Frontend/tests/e2e/ were enhanced with new NL and execution E2E specs.
